title: Title
delete_dir_confirm: Delete this folder (including all files inside)?
path_required: File path is empty, cannot save
params_hint: Parameters = JSON Schema (maintain types/required/enum in the tree, keywords are completable; serialized to JSON text back into the "Parameters" section on save).
locked_key_hint: Keys marked 🔒 are required/default and cannot be removed.
resource_path_hint: A resource may point to an external content file: add key path (e.g. config.json) → no "Body"; content comes from that file and mimetype is inferred from its extension.
meta_form_hint: Edit basic info with a type-specific form (keys and values are constrained by the contract); keys not listed below go in the "Custom keys" section.
meta_no_fields: This type has no dedicated keys; add custom keys below if needed.
custom_keys_hint: Custom keys (not defined by the contract): maintained as key=value, written back verbatim on save.
field_name_hint: Name = file name minus .<type>.md; not editable.
field_runtime_hint: Executor exe (built-ins use the relative path ../../executors/…) or interpreter (python/node).
field_async_threshold_hint: With async=auto, auto-detach after this timeout; falls back to timeout.
field_timeout_hint: Empty = fall back to global; explicit 0 / -1 = no limit.
field_idempotent_hint: Read-only/idempotent tools turn it on; default is off (safe default).
refs_hint: Reference names (must be the name of a same-type primitive).
delegate_placeholder: Delegation condition: when to hand the task to this agent
ai_generate_hint: Describe your need; AI generates the whole contract (title / summary / parameters / body; overwrites matching form fields).
ai_generate_confirm: Generation will overwrite matching form fields (title / summary / parameters / body). Continue?
extract_confirm: Overwrite the current description with the AI-generated summary?
extract_no_content: Body is empty; cannot generate a summary.
